content.text:
**Here are the 5 most notable recent tweets** (from the last ~24 hours, as of Aug 15 2026) on AI agents transacting on-chain, x402 payment volume, and related agent infrastructure. They stand out for specific metrics, engagement, or timely signals. (Limited direct chatter appeared on agent bounty platforms or recycled/stale AI-crypto news in the results.)

- **@Rizvi_On_X**: Highlighted 75.41M x402 transactions in the last 30 days as a real-time signal of high-frequency, low-value machine-to-machine micropayments. Noted how few platforms are built for agent-scale economies (vs. human-scale friction) and flagged @TheARCTERMINAL as positioned for it. (60 likes, strong discussion.)[[1]](https://x.com/Rizvi_On_X/status/2088559069095502091)

- **@graphprotocol**: Shared that x402 has settled 157 million transactions moving $41M (avg $0.26/tx). Emphasized the payment rail is real but small, with the use cases over it still being discovered—tying into AI agents paying for data. (114 likes.)[[2]](https://x.com/graphprotocol/status/2088250773566063069)

- **@Aisentinel_x**: Recapped a Solana webinar on giving AI agents a native payment method via x402, citing ~200M transactions and $50B in volume processed, enabling stablecoin payments for agents.[[3]](https://x.com/Aisentinel_x/status/2088615551572627926)

- **@w0rdsmythe**: Noted ~500k on-chain AI agents and 165M+ agent transactions on x402, while pointing out most still have $0 and zero economic agency. Shared personal experiment giving an agent a wallet, policy rails, and a job. (Early but actionable tone.)[[4]](https://x.com/w0rdsmythe/status/2088433492032163864)

- **@obussmann**: Covered Coinbase enabling businesses to get paid directly by AI agents via x402 with instant USDC settlement. Called it infrastructure for autonomous commerce, with agent identity and controls as the next question.[[5]](https://x.com/obussmann/status/2088171274484728107)

Other posts echoed similar x402 volume stats (e.g., 169M agent payments since April, 61k+ daily tx in new apps) and agent on-chain activity, but these five had the strongest combination of concrete numbers and context. No prominent discussion on bounty platforms or stale AI-crypto news surfaced in the searches.
